errorBody: We couldn't load this information. Try again.

error.validation_failed: Check the details and try again.
error.payment_declined: Your card was declined. Try another card or payment method.

error.not_allowed: This action isn't available to you. Contact support if you need help.
error.not_found: This item is no longer available. Return to your list and try again.
error.expired: The deadline has passed. Refresh the page to see your available actions.
error.rate_limited: There have been too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.limit_reached: You've reached a limit on your account for now. Check the help center for details.
error.unknown: We couldn't complete that action. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
error.identity_required: We need to check your ID first. It takes about 2 minutes.
error.paused: New bookings and payments are paused for a little while. Nothing was booked or charged, so try again later. Bookings you already have go ahead as planned.
error.not_ready: This isn't ready yet. Try again in a few minutes.
